descriptor: Prospective Additive-Law Survival or Defeat, Interaction Residual Localization, Balanced-Factor Geometry & Context-Law Authority Update

interaction_residual_geometry.decomposition: GF(2) two-factor main effects plus six independent 2x2 cycle contrasts relative to measurement-pipeline/u1

representation_interaction_algebra.basis: algebraic normal form over representation coordinates {R,F,H,T,L}
representation_interaction_algebra.interpretation: Every independent context-interaction contrast depends nontrivially on representation coordinates; five of six require degree >=4 and three reach degree 5, so no low-order uniform representation-coordinate interaction law is supported by this exact tensor.

context_law_authority.authority_ceiling: The complete balanced grid requires all six independent GF(2) interaction contrasts. Skin and intervention labels do not currently support a nontrivial predictive context law.

successor_identifiability_problem.question: Are the observed 12 context-cell geometries reproducible properties of the cells, or idiosyncratic to particular world instantiations?
successor_identifiability_problem.next_design: fresh within-cell replication across all 12 balanced cells before introducing new context features or any new transport law

authority: Exact deterministic decomposition of sealed P30 data only; no causal context-law claim, no universal representation law, and no behavioral SVEC promotion.
